blocks.text: The course's INT track covers the professional reading of open sources in Arabic: newspapers, news agencies, institutional sites, press releases and public statements. It is not a form of investigative techniques: it is a form of linguistic method. You learn to understand who says what and with what degree of certainty, to distinguish a fact from an unverified opinion and statement, to compare two versions of the same fact, to document and quote sources, to translate them faithfully and to signal doubts. Learn limits: only public information, no personal data about private citizens, no false identity. All the texts of the unity are invented and concern themes of general chronicle. Two weeks.

Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognising the main types of Arab open source and distinguishing primary and secondary sources;
2. understanding and rendering in English the verbs of attribution and degrees of certainty ( ⁧أَكَّدَ⁩ , ⁧ذَكَرَ⁩ , ⁧زَعَمَ⁩ , ⁧نَفَى⁩ , ⁧يُرَجَّحُ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَتَسَنَّ⁩
3. distinguish fact, opinion and statement that has not been verified;
4. compare two accounts of the same fact and write a neutral summary;
5. fill out a sheet-source and a short press review in English, in compliance with the rules of this Unity. Two-week plan.
